nodes.label: task-id normalization (FR-WORKTREE-MAKEDECISION-002 / data-contracts Contract 3)
nodes.rationale: make-decision must normalize human task-id input before validation: lowercase, replace non-alphanumeric with hyphens, collapse consecutive hyphens, trim edge hyphens, then validate ^[a-z]+(-[a-z]+){1,2}$; e.g. 'Worktree Unification' -> 'worktree-unification', 'My_Feature123' fails loud.
